# DSH Studio v0.9.21

## Changes and safety

- Preserve managed Harness precedence, import/require conditional exports and Profile extension fallback. Keep staged startup qualification, previous-runtime preservation and unsaved-document guards.
- Expand cold-install/full-boot CI to Node 22.19.0 and 24.21.0 on Windows, Linux and macOS.

## Fixes and polish

- Fix synchronous resolution-hook recursion on newer Node releases that stalled installation, repair or startup after `Node entered managed startup`, followed by the 120-second port-announcement timeout.
- Keep native window controls above error and recovery overlays. Unsaved drafts still block closure, while a running main window can hide to the tray.
- Grant the exact window permissions required by Tauri close callbacks, fixing `window.destroy not allowed`. Prevent destruction before hiding a running main window, preserving its Harness and unsaved draft.
- Canonicalize the macOS npm test directory and working directory; isolate concurrent plugin recovery fixtures with atomic sequence numbers.

## Installation

- Upgrade from `v0.9.20`, then use runtime installation or repair to apply updated managed startup support. Full/Offline and Lite packages remain available across the existing five-target release matrix; Windows portable builds require the adjacent `dist/` directory.

## Verification

- Reproduce the old 120-second stall on Windows/Node 24.21.0, then boot the same Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 fixture in about 26 seconds after replacing only the resolver. Native cold installs also pass for Harness 0.1.1-rc.2.
- Validate real Full archive restoration/repair and failure preservation, signed update downloads and rejection paths. The startup fix passed all 11 CI jobs; local regression includes 653 frontend, 142 packaging and 562 Rust tests with 99.33% frontend line coverage.
- Exercise all eight desktop routes, six selectors, native ACL/profile/preset/session operations, long-session bounds, PTY layouts, preference reload, Git review/retry and three Harness stop/start cycles in an isolated Windows WebView.
- Click the actual install and repair controls for Node 24.21.0 / Harness 0.1.1-rc.2 and verify update-check completion. Hit-tested pointer events verify maximize/restore/minimize/close through error overlays, unsaved-draft cancellation, running-window tray hiding with draft preservation, and clean process exit after saving and stopping. External credentials, paid providers, Narrator and physical macOS/Linux interaction are outside this local evidence.
